Class CasseroleProperties

java.lang.Object
org.casserole.config.CasseroleProperties
@ConfigurationProperties(prefix="casserole") public class CasseroleProperties extends Object
The CasseroleProperties type is the bound casserole.* configuration. The type holds the SSH listen settings, the chat settings, the Lamina settings, the Grok settings, and the pool settings. SSH is the secure-shell protocol a client uses to connect. Each section starts as a new object with that section's defaults. Spring Boot binds the yaml values into these objects. Spring Boot is the framework that fills this type at startup.

    • getPool

      public CasseroleProperties.Pool getPool()
      The getPool method returns the pool settings. The window is the value bound from casserole.pool.context-window. The host and the port name a remote grok agent serve seat. A blank host keeps the local child.
      Returns:
      The CasseroleProperties.Pool section.

    • setPool

      public void setPool(CasseroleProperties.Pool pool)
      The setPool method stores the pool section. If pool is null, the method stores a new CasseroleProperties.Pool with the default window of 0.
      Parameters:
      pool - The pool settings to store, or null to store a fresh section.
